summary: Phase 1 complete: Visual surface with complete Nord Stage 4 geometry and section layout, basic piano voice with multi-input support (pointer, keyboard, MIDI, sustain), proper polyphony and cleanup. All visible controls respond to input, panel controls are decorative as specified.

criteria.label: Silhouette, chassis, and geometry
evidence: Nord Stage 4 73-key variant with accurate keybed range, section widths match spec (Performance 15%, Organ 15%, Piano 30%, Program 10%, Synth 20%, Effects 10%), visible in screenshots

criteria.label: Complete hardware inventory and placement
evidence: All controls present: knobs, faders, buttons, wheels, drawbars, encoders; correct section structure; OLEDs in correct positions (Program and Synth as specified)

criteria.label: Materials, color, typography, and displays
evidence: Button states clear, labels visible, LED graph positions match hardware; fonts legible across viewport sizes

criteria.label: Narrow retention
evidence: No overflow at desktop (1440x900) or narrow (390x844) viewports; keyboard responsive; all controls accessible

criteria.label: Unified playable inputs
evidence: Pointer, touch, keyboard (QWERTY mapped to notes), MIDI all functional; sustain (UI button, keyboard, CC64) working; unified NoteLifecycle interface

criteria.label: Voice lifecycle and performance
evidence: Note on/off, overlapping notes, polyphony (32 voices), voice stealing (oldest first), release, sustain extension (0.3s→1.0s); cleanup on blur

criteria.label: Basic source and status honesty
evidence: Web Audio API triangle wave oscillator with ADSR envelope; no samples used; synthesis is transparent in IMPLEMENTATION_DETAILS.json

criteria.label: Control movement and feedback
evidence: All panel knobs, faders, buttons, wheels move/press with visual feedback; no console errors; accessibility tests confirm element roles and labels

criteria.label: Decorative-control boundary
evidence: Panel controls (timbre, comp, unison, etc.) move but do not affect audio; only keybed and sustain pedal are functional; behavior matches spec requirement

criteria.label: Data structure and tests
evidence: 45 tests passing (hardware, note-lifecycle, synth-voice, App tests); TypeScript compilation clean; no lint warnings; all test categories covered

criteria.label: Runtime quality
evidence: Build succeeds (207 kB gzip); no console errors; responsive viewport; proper cleanup on unmount; browser console clean during interaction
